blockers.description: lnurlcash-kernel only ships manylinux wheels + sdist (native libbitcoinkernel); violates no-new-deps rule and is platform-fragile. Arbitrary cw1 script-path spends genuinely need it; ck1 + bearer short form are reimplementable in pure python (coincurve + taproot math already analyzed).
blockers.workaround: pure-python reimplementation of kernel's portable modules; optional kernel import for arbitrary cw1

human_actions_pending.action: Decide scope: full new-protocol port vs subset; how to handle lnurlcash-kernel dependency
human_actions_pending.context: Breaking protocol change; new deps decision conflicts with CLAUDE.md no-new-deps constraint

decisions.decision: Keep per-mint coincurve keypair for signing (Option B already in repo), switch to 'Lightning Signed Message' double-sha256 wrap + cs1 encoding per new spec
decisions.rationale: upstream signmessage RPC / spark paths don't map to LNbits; per-mint key already deployed
